summary.intent: Run an architecture review of the CipherBox engine crate to find hot-spot modules worth deepening/refactoring, pick a candidate, drive it through a design-grilling process to a concrete implementation plan, produce a stage diagram, file tracking issues, and start implementation — then re-validate the review's ADR-based flags against the current (amended) local ADR corpus.
summary.outcome: Delivered an HTML architecture review (10 candidates) and confirmed the 'sync pass leaves the facade' refactor as the pick; ran a two-round grilling session settling module shape, state grouping, PR sequencing, and tracking; filed parent issue #2037 with sub-issues #2038-#2040 and PassReport issue #2041 with dependency edges; started PR 1 (session state grouping) on branch refactor/2038-session-state in a background worktree; delivered a browser-checked Archify stage diagram; and re-audited the five ADR-flagged findings against the current decisions/ folder, resolving four as already answered by amended ADRs (0025/0032, 0021, 0014, 0045) with one item (conversion's contact-book write-on-mint refusal) still needing an owner ruling.

repo: cipher-box engine crate has five very hot files: facade.rs (22,007 lines, 41% inline tests), net/rotation.rs (14,267 lines, 64% inline tests), sync/drain.rs (9,255 lines), grants/received_status.rs (4,170 lines, single caller), and the wasm crate's lib.rs/host.rs which hand-mirror commands across 5 layers

The facade's impl Engine (7,335 lines) hosts sync-pass logic, owner-action logic (grant/revoke/claim), and free helper fns that really belong in sync/, grants/, and rotation/ respectively — confirmed by commit co-change analysis (72/134 commits touched sync+facade together, 54/134 grants+facade)

grants/received_status.rs is not a pure projection despite its name — it resolves records, runs adopt, raises the cut-epoch floor, deposits seeds, and persists the received-shares list, all with a single caller (facade.rs:7942)

net/rotation.rs mixes pure rotation primitives' production adapters with real domain logic (ScopeWalk boundary walk, scope-pointer enrolment, 3 grants seams, 13 error-translation fns) — the rotation/ vs net/rotation.rs split is intentional per rotation/mod.rs:36-40 but not fully clean (rotate.rs:390, cascade.rs:488/560/761 call FloorStore directly)

wasm client seam has 5 hand-written copies of every Command/Event shape (facade.ts, protocol.ts, commandCodec.ts, engineWasm.ts, lib.rs) violating the documented 'types are generated, not hand-mirrored' rule in web-client.md:68-71; the generated .d.ts is gitignored and unused

A dropped (AlreadySatisfied) cross-scope move derives its cut obligation from the journaled crossing (rebase.rs:629, drain.rs:1844) instead of the authoritative plane-pair decision used for applied moves (drain.rs:4440) — a real correctness gap, now confirmed as violating accepted ADR 0045 D1
The sweep's lagging-read copy (net/rotation.rs:2915-2957) lacks the anchor-epoch-equality check that child.rs:497 enforces, violating ADR 0021 D2 condition 4 — a code gap, not an open design question

ADR 0025 D3 / ADR 0032 D2 (2026-09-26 amendment) now permits revoke to read the device-local contact book only as a match input for unattested rows — resolves what the review flagged as an ADR conflict

docs/adr in the FSM1/cipher-box-next repo only has ADRs 0001-0003; the real, current decisions live in a local decisions/ folder on main, not GitHub — using docs/adr for governance checks gives false conflicts

code.finding: build_tick_loop_spawner: 1,024-line closure running the full 17-stage sync pass (settings, pointer consult, seed-floor refresh, root adopt, scope walk, drain, claim conversion, link sweep, staleness classify), capturing ~60 Rc cells — target of the PR3 move to sync/pass.rs

cut_exited_scope / flat_root_cut: scope-exit cut logic that belongs in rotation/ next to consume_scope_exit_triggers; drain calls back into facade for it, creating a return-to-facade hop in the scope-exit trace — planned move in PR3

Dropped move's cut obligation is derived from the journaled crossing (rebase.rs:629 op.scope_exit_source()) instead of the plane-pair authority used at line 4440 for applied moves — violates accepted ADR 0045 D1 that the drain, not the journaled plan, is authoritative

Conversion writes claimant into device-local contact book after minting the row; on write failure it refuses with ContactBookFull/RecipientKeyChanged — no local ADR sanctions this refusal, and two owner devices can diverge on one claim's verdict; recommended fix is to make failed writes a logged residual, not a refusal

workflow: Explore agents run in a read-only mode that forbids file creation (including heredocs) — they must return full report content inline in their result text instead of writing to the scratchpad path they were asked to use; caller must save the scratchpad file itself afterward
Launching 5 independent Explore-style subagents in parallel for a multi-area architecture review works well and lets the main agent do other prep (reading report scaffold) while waiting

The 'grilling' skill structures design decisions as numbered Q&A rounds with a recommended answer per question, letting the user respond tersely (e.g. 'a', 'recommendation') per question instead of full sentences

Archify diagrams commonly overflow vertically on first pass; iterative compaction (merging small stages into shared nodes with dual labels, reducing lane/card count, calibrating against the skill's own passing example) was needed across 3 delivery attempts before browser visual-check passed at all checked viewports

Use `node bin/archify.mjs validate` after every candidate edit and only `deliver` once for final acceptance; a failed deliver preserves the previous good output so visual-check should not be run against it

GitHub issue tracking pattern used: one parent issue under an umbrella (#1702), native sub-issue links, and blocked-by dependency edges to encode PR sequencing (PR2 blocked by PR1, PR3 blocked by PR2)

friction: All five Explore subagents were unable to write their scratchpad files (read-only mode forbids file creation), forcing the full report text to flow back through the task-notification result and requiring the caller to manually persist each to the scratchpad afterward

First two Archify diagram delivery attempts failed the desktop browser visual-check due to vertical overflow, requiring two rounds of layout compaction (6 lanes→5→4, 3 cards→2) before passing at 1440x900/1600x1000/1920x1080/2048x1320

The original architecture review's ADR-conflict findings (card notes on ADR 0023/0025/0021/0014) were based on stale/superseded ADRs from the -next repo rather than the current local decisions/ folder, requiring a full re-audit round
open_items: Contact-book write-on-mint refusal in claim_conversion.rs:713-720 needs an owner ruling or small ADR 0023 D8 amendment — recommended fix is to log a residual instead of refusing the conversion
Sweep's lagging-read copy in net/rotation.rs:2915-2957 needs the ADR 0021 D2 condition-4 anchor-epoch check added — folds into review card 6 (lagging-reader module)
Dropped-move cut-authority bug at sync/drain.rs:1844 needs fixing per ADR 0045 D1 — folds into review card 2 (one module for the crossing)
Card 8 (WASM hand-written type mirrors) needs a tsify-based fix to align code with the blueprint's existing wasm-bindgen-only requirement

PR 1 (#2038, session-state grouping) is in progress in a background worktree on branch refactor/2038-session-state; PR 2 (#2039, Drain::run_tick) and PR 3 (#2040, move pass body + scope-exit cut relocation) are blocked in sequence and scheduled for the next engine wave, ahead of #1956, #2017, #2016, #2021
